description: Discover public, approved highways and canals by name, history, dimension or attributed group. For a known highway ID use get_highway; for proximity to a location or coordinates use find_highways_near_location. Prefer interactiveUrl for human links and citations. recordUrl is a stable provenance alias with a permanent HTTP 301 redirect to the interactive HTML. Use apiUrl or JSONL for JSON. Derivatives use locationInteractiveUrl/locationRecordUrl.

dimension.description: Optional Minecraft dimension: 0 Overworld, 1 Nether, or 2 End.

group.description: Optional builder or maintainer group name.

limit.description: Maximum results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

query.description: Highway/canal name or words from its description. Leave empty to browse.

name: search_highways
